よう、そこの いい盾持ってる兄ちゃん！ どこから来たんだい？
Entry.EnglishText: Hey buddy, nice shield ya got there! Say, where ya from?

Entry.JapaneseText: え、オレの事？ シーブル村からだよ
Entry.EnglishText: Who, me? I’m from Seable.

Entry.JapaneseText: シーブル村！ 奇遇だなぁ〜！ 俺もそこの生まれなんだ
Entry.EnglishText: Did you say Seable? Get out! I was born there!

Entry.JapaneseText: え、ホント!? 偶然だねぇ！
Entry.EnglishText: Whoa, really?! What are the odds!

Entry.JapaneseText: ホント、ホント!! いやぁ、懐かしいなぁ！ こりゃあ、他人とは思えねぇ
Entry.EnglishText: Not even kidding! Ahh, good times! Hope everyone's still doing well.

Entry.JapaneseText: よっし、特別に半額にするから 鎧買わないか？ それほどの 盾には、いい鎧もなくちゃ！
Entry.EnglishText: See this armor here? Just for you my Seable brother, I'll cut the price in half! That shield needs some armor to match!

Entry.JapaneseText: スゴイよ、<Hisui>！ 鎧が半額だって!!
Entry.EnglishText: You hear that, Hisui?! Half price!

Entry.JapaneseText: バカ！ そんな簡単に のせられるんじゃねぇよ！
Entry.EnglishText: How dumb are you?! That's like, the oldest trick in the freakin' book!

Entry.JapaneseText: そう、だまされてはダメです。 この店の防具はどれも 半額の価値もない粗悪品ですよ
Entry.EnglishText: Don't listen to a word that guy says. His stuff wouldn't be worth it even if it WAS half off.

Entry.JapaneseText: なんだぁ、この野郎！ 言いがかりつける気か？
Entry.EnglishText: What the hell, man?! That's some big talk!

Entry.JapaneseText: では、試してみましょう。 あなたがその鎧を着て 私の店の剣で突くと……
Entry.EnglishText: Wanna prove it? Go on, put on that armor and let's see if it can stand up to one of my swords.

Entry.JapaneseText: そ、それは…… くそぉ、覚えてやがれ！
Entry.EnglishText: Wh-What're you?! Argh, dammit! I’ll remember this!

Entry.JapaneseText: 魔物が増えたせいで、素人をだます 悪徳商人が増えましてね…… 同じ商人としてお詫びします
Entry.EnglishText: Due to the rise in monster activity, a lotta merchants have stooped to scamming. On behalf of all us honest merchants, I apologize.

Entry.JapaneseText: シーブル村の人が 人をだますなんて……
Entry.EnglishText: I can't believe he tried to scam me! How could someone from Seable do such a thing?

Entry.JapaneseText: あのなぁ、同じ村出身なんて 出まかせに決まってんだろ？
Entry.EnglishText: You don't REALLY believe he “just so happened” to be from Seable, did you?

Entry.JapaneseText: ははぁ、そちらの方は お若いのによくわかって いらっしゃる
Entry.EnglishText: Haha, you've sure got a good head on your shoulders for a lad your age.

Entry.JapaneseText: へっ、こいつと違って それなりに旅を してきてるんでね
Entry.EnglishText: Heh. I know my way around better than this kid, at least.

Entry.JapaneseText: あんた、都会もんにしちゃ 信用できそうだな。 聞きたい事があんだけど？
Entry.EnglishText: I know you can't go around trusting any old rando on the street. By the way, can I ask you something?

Entry.JapaneseText: ほう……？ では、私の店へ いらっしゃいませんか？
Entry.EnglishText: Oh? Then why don't we move this conversation to my store?

Entry.JapaneseText: ぐふふ……狼は何匹？ 奴らは群れなす狩人。愚かな子羊は 開いたアギトへ自ら飛びこむ……
Entry.EnglishText: Hehe... I wonder how many wolves are on the prowl tonight? They hunt in packs, y'know. Tread carefully, little lambs...

Entry.JapaneseText: そうだ、そちらのお嬢さんに ピッタリの軽量鎧があるんですよ。 よかったら見てください
Entry.EnglishText: I've got just the bit of armor for the little lady. Wanna take a look?

Entry.JapaneseText: うぉ!? どれも高けぇなッ!!
Entry.EnglishText: Bloody hell! Everything's so freakin' expensive!

Entry.JapaneseText: 人が命を預ける武具は 値段ではなく まず品質を見るものですよね？
Entry.EnglishText: If you want a gear you'll entrust with your life, surely the quality matters more than the price.

Entry.JapaneseText: た、確かにモノは さっきの店とは大違い…… ……だな、うん
Entry.EnglishText: W-Well, seems like a huge step up from that other guy's, if nothing else...

Entry.JapaneseText: 鎧はいらないよ。最近この街で デスピル病が起こってないか 聞きたいだけなんだ
Entry.EnglishText: We’re not looking to buy any armor. We just wanted to know if there's any despir going around town recently.

Entry.JapaneseText: ふむ……心当たりはありますが 商人にとって情報こそが最大の 商品でありまして……
Entry.EnglishText: Hmm... I may know a thing or two, but it'll cost you. Information is every merchant’s most valuable product.

Entry.JapaneseText: ……わかった。<Kohaku>用に 鎧をひとつ買うぜ。その代わり 情報はサービスしてくれよ
Entry.EnglishText: Fine. We'll buy that thing for Kohaku, so you better spill everything you know.

Entry.JapaneseText: ありがとうございます！ さすが世慣れてる方は 交渉がお上手だ
Entry.EnglishText: That's what I like to hear! Leave it to a streetwise lad to drive such a hard bargain.

Entry.JapaneseText: ……では、私もサービスで 無料情報をひとつ
Entry.EnglishText: ...Allow me to add an additional piece of information, free of charge.

Entry.JapaneseText: 先ほどの商人と、この者は ふたり一組の悪徳商人ですよ
Entry.EnglishText: Both of those merchants are a pair of infamous conmen, known for plotting together.

Entry.JapaneseText: あ、あなたは…… チェン商館のエカイユさん
Entry.EnglishText: I-It's Ecaille from the Chen Corporation!

Entry.JapaneseText: ひとり目のインチキを、ふたり目 が暴いて信用させ、同じ粗悪品を 高値で売る……古い手口です
Entry.EnglishText: The second merchant exposes the first to gain your trust, only to sell the same faulty product at a higher price. One of the oldest tricks in the book.

Entry.JapaneseText: しかし、派手にやりすぎですね。 街のギルドにまで 苦情が届き始めています
Entry.EnglishText: But they got cocky. Many have started filing complaints, which have made their way to our guild office.

Entry.JapaneseText: チェン大人（ターレン）からの お達しです。 ……『わきまえろ』と
Entry.EnglishText: I come bearing a message from Papa Chen: He says “know your place.”

Entry.JapaneseText: くぅ、わ、わかりました…… チェン大人に逆らっては商人の 世界で生きていけませんからね
Entry.EnglishText: Damn... G-Got it. Every merchant knows you don't dare cross Papa Chen.

Entry.JapaneseText: ……ここの鎧も『粗悪品』だって
Entry.EnglishText: ...So this armor is junk too, huh?

Entry.JapaneseText: うっせえーよ！ てめぇは一段目で ひっかかっただろーが!!
Entry.EnglishText: Oh shut up! Like you're one to talk, you fell for it first!

Entry.JapaneseText: 彼らも、以前は真面目に商売を していたのですが……最近 街の商売が荒れて困っています
Entry.EnglishText: They used to be such honest merchants... Problems keep arising across many businesses. It's given us at the guild quite the headache.

Entry.JapaneseText: お姉さんは、街の情報に詳しいの？
Entry.EnglishText: You sure know a whole lot about what’s going on in this city, ma’am.

Entry.JapaneseText: 詳しいのは我が主、チェンです。 大人（ターレン）は、街の全てを 知っておられます。例えば……
Entry.EnglishText: Not as much as my boss, Papa Chen. Papa knows everything there is to know about this city.

Entry.JapaneseText: 今、ソーマ使いの若者たちが 何を探しているか…… ……という事までね
Entry.EnglishText: Even something such as... what it is some young Somatics fresh in town are searching for.

Entry.JapaneseText: ぜひチェン商館をお尋ねください。 ソーマ使いの方々となら、きっと よい取り引きができるでしょう
Entry.EnglishText: Feel free to inquire at the Chen Corporation. I'm sure Papa has some good offers for fine Somatics such as yourselves.

Entry.JapaneseText: ……これも ふたり目のインチキを暴いて 三人目を信用させる手口??
Entry.EnglishText: ...So is this the next part of the con where a THIRD person comes in to expose the last guy as a liar to make you trust THEM?!

Entry.JapaneseText: あ〜〜〜、この街はなんだッ！ 誰も信用できねぇよ!!
Entry.EnglishText: This place blows! You can’t trust anyone here!

Entry.JapaneseText: でも、他にスピルーンの 手がかりがない……とにかく チェンって人に会ってみようよ
Entry.EnglishText: But it's not like we have any other leads on the Spirune. Guess we should pay Papa Chen a visit.

Entry.JapaneseText: チェンめ、あのソーマ使い たちを雇う気なのか……
Entry.EnglishText: Stupid Chen. You gonna “hire” those Somatics too?

Entry.JapaneseText: ああ！ こっちだよ、あんたたち！
Entry.EnglishText: Oh! Over here, you two!

Entry.JapaneseText: あんたたちが、近くにいるはず だから、呼んできてくれって <Ines>さんに頼まれたのよ
Entry.EnglishText: Ms Ines asked me to call for you if I saw you.

Entry.JapaneseText: 呼んできて？ <Ines>は動けないほどの 怪我をしてんのか？
Entry.EnglishText: Call for us? Don't tell me she's hurt so bad she can't even move?!

Entry.JapaneseText: ……体は無事だけど、 ひどくスピリアが 傷ついてるんだよ……
Entry.EnglishText: ...Her body is fine, but her Spiria took quite the beating...

Entry.JapaneseText: でも、あんたたち よく無事に、この街に たどり着けたねぇ
Entry.EnglishText: But what matters is that you two made it here safe and sound.

Entry.JapaneseText: 今、見た事のない凶暴な魔物が あふれ出して、行商人たちが 何人も大怪我をしてるんだよ
Entry.EnglishText: There's been the awful monsters like I've never seen before show up out of nowhere! Many merchants have been seriously injured on the roads.

Entry.JapaneseText: 見た事のない凶暴な魔物…… やっぱりゼロムがあちこちで 実体化してるのか
Entry.EnglishText: Awful monster you've never seen...? So xerom really are popping up all over the place.

Entry.JapaneseText: とにかく<Ines>さんに 会っておくれよ。 うちの宿の二階で休んでるから
Entry.EnglishText: At any rate, you should go see Ms Ines. She's resting upstairs at the inn.

Entry.JapaneseText: ああ、みんな無事だったんだね！
Entry.EnglishText: Oh am I glad to see you're all all right!

Entry.JapaneseText: 女将さんこそ 無事でよかった
Entry.EnglishText: Same to you!

Entry.JapaneseText: 女将さん、ラピスは……？
Entry.EnglishText: Um, how's Lapis doing...?

Entry.JapaneseText: ……それが かなり弱まってるんだよ
Entry.EnglishText: She's still quite weak...

Entry.JapaneseText: 世界はこんなありさまだし 医者にも診せたんだけど どうにもならなくて……
Entry.EnglishText: I tried to find a doctor, but with the state the world's in, I had no luck...

Entry.JapaneseText: <Ines>、急いで ラピスにスピルーンを戻そう！
Entry.EnglishText: Ines, we need to give her Spirune back quick!

Entry.JapaneseText: え、ええ…… でも…………
Entry.EnglishText: R-Right. But...

Entry.JapaneseText: 『でも』も 『でもも』もないじゃない！
Entry.EnglishText: Now's not the time for "buts!"

Entry.JapaneseText: ラピスを目覚めさせるために 白い月と黒い月から 帰ってきたんだ
Entry.EnglishText: Waking Lapis was your whole reason for making it back from the Ivory AND Ebony Moons!

Entry.JapaneseText: ふたりとも、そんなに <Ines>を急かしては……
Entry.EnglishText: You two shouldn't pressure her so much...

Entry.JapaneseText: げへへ、見つけたぜぇ……
Entry.EnglishText: Geheh, ya see that boys?

Entry.JapaneseText: エメラルドの髪の女と ソーマ使いどもだ
Entry.EnglishText: A chick with emerald hair and a pack of Somatics...

Entry.JapaneseText: ごめんなさい。 卵もトマトもほうれん草も 品切れなのよ……
Entry.EnglishText: I'm so sorry, but we're out of all those...

Entry.JapaneseText: こんな時こそ しっかり品物をそろえるのが 商人の役目なのに……
Entry.EnglishText: Even though it's a merchant's duty to stock up on goods at a time like this...

Entry.JapaneseText: いえ、事情はわかります。 こちらこそ無理を言って ごめんなさい
Entry.EnglishText: Don't worry, I understand completely. Sorry for such an unreasonable request.

Entry.JapaneseText: どうしよう…… こんなに食料が不足してるなんて 思わなかった
Entry.EnglishText: What now... I didn't think there would be such a shortage of food.

Entry.JapaneseText: 今の食材を そろえる心当たりがありますよ
Entry.EnglishText: I have an idea on how to gather those ingredients.

Entry.JapaneseText: あっ、オレを だまそうとした悪徳商人！
Entry.EnglishText: Hey, you're the merchants that tried to scam me!

Entry.JapaneseText: 今は真面目に商売してるってば！ ……全く、田舎者は 古い事を根に持ちやがる……
Entry.EnglishText: We're on the straight and narrow now! Geez... you country bumpkins sure know how to hold a grudge...

Entry.JapaneseText: 宿屋の女将さんから聞きました。 娘さんのために必要なんですね？
Entry.EnglishText: We heard all about it from the innkeeper's wife. You need them for this young lady's daughter, yeah?

Entry.JapaneseText: 今日、生鮮食品を満載した船が 南の船着場に入るらしい。 行ってみるといい
Entry.EnglishText: I heard a ship carrying fresh produce will be arriving at the docks today. You should go check it out.

Entry.JapaneseText: ……ただで情報を教えるなんて どういうつもり？
Entry.EnglishText: ...And what do you expect in return for the free info?

Entry.JapaneseText: ……俺たちにも子どもがいるんだ。 必死になる親の気持ちはわかるぜ
Entry.EnglishText: I have kids myself, see. I can just relate to a parents struggle.

Entry.JapaneseText: それに、今の状況は 信頼を取り戻す絶好の チャンスでもあるんです
Entry.EnglishText: Besides, this is a great opportunity to try and regain our customer's trust.

Entry.JapaneseText: 世界のピンチを乗り切って 私たちは正義の商人として 再出発してみせますよ！
Entry.EnglishText: We wanna start fresh, then we'll be known as the heroic merchants who came through even when the world has gone to hell!

Entry.JapaneseText: ありがとう。 南の船着場に行ってみるわ
Entry.EnglishText: Thank you. We'll go try the southern harbor then.

Entry.JapaneseText: ふたりの心意気 買わせてもらうよ！
Entry.EnglishText: I'm glad you two had a change of heart!

Entry.JapaneseText: 毎度ありぃ！
Entry.EnglishText: Pleasure doing business with you!

Entry.JapaneseText: 毎度ありぃ！
Entry.EnglishText: Pleasure doing business with you!

Entry.JapaneseText: ……聞いたか？
Entry.EnglishText: ...Y'hear that?

Entry.JapaneseText: ああ、あのソーマ女の娘か…… 使えそうだな
Entry.EnglishText: Sure did. Those Soma them ladies got... they look like they'd make a pretty penny.

Entry.JapaneseText: あっ、絵を描いてる子がいる
Entry.EnglishText: Oh hey, that girl is painting something.

Entry.JapaneseText: 見るなっ！
Entry.EnglishText: No peeking!

Entry.JapaneseText: ……あんた、ボクの絵を盗作して 帝国芸術院コンクールに 応募するつもりなんでしょ？
Entry.EnglishText: ...You're trying to plagiarize my painting and enter it into the Imperial Art Academy Competition, aren't you?!

Entry.JapaneseText: 盗作？ 芸術院コンクール?? 何を言ってるんだよ？
Entry.EnglishText: Plagiarize? Imperial Art Academy Competition? What're you talking about?

Entry.JapaneseText: ……ふん！ 『しばらっくれ』ても お見と〜しなんだよっ
Entry.EnglishText: Hmph! Don't pray dumb with me!

Entry.JapaneseText: ……それを言うなら 『しらばっくれる』じゃないの？
Entry.EnglishText: ...Don't you mean "play" dumb?

Entry.JapaneseText: だ、だまされないぞ！ 芸術泥棒が『おこまがしい』よっ！ あっちへ行けぇっ
Entry.EnglishText: Y-You can't fool me! You art thieves are so presumpionable ! Now get lost!

Entry.JapaneseText: な、なんだよ？ 街の人って訳わかんないな……
Entry.EnglishText: Wh-What was that about? I don't get these cityfolk...

Entry.JapaneseText: ふん、盗作子羊め…… さっさと狼のエサになっちゃえ……
Entry.EnglishText: Hmph, stupid plagiarizing lambs... Hurry up and get eaten by wolves already...

Entry.JapaneseText: きみたち…… なんとか魔物退治を お願いできないだろうか？
『魔物の狩場』で また商隊がやられたか……
Entry.EnglishText: Sounds like another merchant caravan was attacked passing through the monster hunting grounds...

Entry.JapaneseText: 以前は、集団なら問題なく 通リ抜けられる場所だったのに
Entry.EnglishText: It wasn't like this before.

Entry.JapaneseText: うむ、魔物どもが どんどん凶暴化している
Entry.EnglishText: Yeah, the monsters seem to be getting more and more aggressive.

Entry.JapaneseText: このままではヘンゼラだけでなく このペンデローク大陸の 流通が大打撃を受けるぞ
Entry.EnglishText: If this keeps up, not only will it be bad for Hanselar, but the distribution of goods across the whole Pendeloque continent is in trouble.

Entry.JapaneseText: 『魔物の狩場』って…… 結晶騎士野郎と出会った場所か？
Entry.EnglishText: Monster hunting grounds... Isn't that where we ran into that Crystal Knight?

Entry.JapaneseText: 結晶騎士だって！ バレイア教会の結晶騎士様が 近くにいるのかい？
Entry.EnglishText: Did you say Crystal Knight? Are they still in the area?

Entry.JapaneseText: 頼むよ、騎士様の 居場所を教えてくれ！
Entry.EnglishText: Please tell us where they are, we need their help!

Entry.JapaneseText: カルセドニーの居場所!? そ、それは……
Entry.EnglishText: Where'd Chalcedony go?! W-Weeell...

Entry.JapaneseText: ああまで凶暴化した魔物は 我々の手には負えない
Entry.EnglishText: The monster's are too vicious, we can't handle them by ourselves.

Entry.JapaneseText: ソーマを持つ 結晶騎士様だけが 頼りなんだ
Entry.EnglishText: A Crystal Knight's Soma is our only hope.

Entry.JapaneseText: へっ、そーでもねぇさ。 俺たちも、このソーマで 魔物の狩場を抜けたんだ
Entry.EnglishText: Heh, not necessarily. We also just so happen to be Somatics who made it through the hunting grounds.

Entry.JapaneseText: きみたちも ソーマ使いなのか!?
Entry.EnglishText: Did you say Somatics?!

Entry.JapaneseText: なら、狩場の魔物退治を お願いできないだろうか？
Entry.EnglishText: In that case, would you please help exterminate the monsters?

Entry.JapaneseText: ……いいよ。 あんな危険な場所は なんとかしなくっちゃ
Entry.EnglishText: ...All right. It's not safe to just leave them be.

Entry.JapaneseText: えぇ〜!? そんな危ない寄り道は 反対〜〜〜っ！
Entry.EnglishText: Are you for real?! I for one am NOT on board with dropping everything to marching to our graves!

Entry.JapaneseText: けど、オレたちだって カルセドニーが助けて くれなかったら死んでたよ
Entry.EnglishText: But we also would've died back there if it weren't for his help.

Entry.JapaneseText: ごめんね、<Kohaku>。 ちょっとだけ寄り道させてね
Entry.EnglishText: Sorry, <Kohaku>. It's just a little detour.

Entry.JapaneseText: ……うん
Entry.EnglishText: ...Yeah!

Entry.JapaneseText: ……いいぜ。教会野郎の 助けなんかなくたって魔物を 倒せた事を証明してやるぜ！
Entry.EnglishText: Let's go. I'll show him I coulda taken those monsters without the bloody church's charity!

Entry.JapaneseText: おお、ありがとう！ 商品が届くのを待っている 人々のためにもお願いします
Entry.EnglishText: Oh, thank you so much! Please go and wait for the client to arrive.

Entry.JapaneseText: ……悪ィが断るぜ。 後戻りしている 余裕はないんでな
ごめんなさい…… オレたちの目的は スピルーンを探す事なんだ
ボクは、普通に怖いから 断るよ！
……そうか。 無理強いはできないな……
街道を北に進んだところが 『魔物の狩場』だよ。 頼む、旅商人たちの仇を討ってくれ
痛てて…… 生きてますか……相棒？
Entry.EnglishText: Ouch. You still alive over there, pal?

Entry.JapaneseText: うう、なんとか……な。 あの女騎士、ウチの鎧を 全部切り裂いていきやがった
Entry.EnglishText: Somehow... That knight chick did a number on my armor.

Entry.JapaneseText: クズ鎧とはいえスゴイなぁ。 だましちゃいけない客って いるんですねぇ……
Entry.EnglishText: I know your armor sucks, but man, she REALLY trashed it. Guess there's some customers you just shouldn't cross...

Entry.JapaneseText: ……そもそもよぉ。 なんで俺たち 客をだましてたんだっけ？
Entry.EnglishText: ...Y'know. Why did we start scamming customers in the first place?

Entry.JapaneseText: そりゃ……客が信用できないから、 先にだましてやろうと…… ……したんですよね？
Entry.EnglishText: Well... You can never trust a customer, so I guess we tried to betray them first... right?

Entry.JapaneseText: ……こりゃあ 天罰ってやつかなぁ？
Entry.EnglishText: ...Maybe this is what you'd call karma.

Entry.JapaneseText: ……ですねぇ
Entry.EnglishText: ...Probably.

Entry.JapaneseText: あの騎士の武器すごかったな…… 俺もあんなすげぇ武器に負けない 防具を扱ってみたいぜ……
あたた……体は痛いけど スピリアは、なんだか ほっとしたような……？
あ〜、もうっ！ あ〜、もうっ！
Entry.EnglishText: Uuugh, I can't decide!

Entry.JapaneseText: こんなに商品があふれてちゃ 決められやしない!!
Entry.EnglishText: How am I supposed to choose from all these products?!

Entry.JapaneseText: まったく困っちゃうわねっ！
Entry.EnglishText: Argh, what's a girl to do?!

Entry.JapaneseText: どこに出ますか？
Entry.EnglishText: Where are you going?

Entry.JapaneseText: フィールドに出る 街道に出る
Entry.EnglishText: To Field. To pathways.

アクセサリ屋
いらっしゃいませ。 当店自慢のアクセサリを 見ていってね
Entry.EnglishText: Welcome. We take pride in our accessories here, so feel free to take a look.

Entry.JapaneseText: またおこしくださいね
Entry.EnglishText: Come again.

Entry.JapaneseText: ヘンゼラは 『ペンデローク大陸の台所』って 呼ばれる街なのよ
Entry.EnglishText: Hanselar is a city known as the “kitchen of the Pendeloque continent”.

Entry.JapaneseText: ……けど、台所だけに、近頃は ゴキブリみたいな悪どい商売を する奴も増えてるから注意してね
Entry.EnglishText: ...But lately there's been more people doing sketchy business, like cockroaches running around a kitchen. Be careful.

Entry.JapaneseText: ヘンゼラは活気があって ビックリするでしょ
Entry.EnglishText: I bet just how bustling Hanselar is must've been quite the shock.

Entry.JapaneseText: この街の活気は 商人が誇りを持って 商売をしてる証さ！
Entry.EnglishText: The liveliness of the city is proof our merchants are proud of their business!

Entry.JapaneseText: いくつものキャラバン隊が 夢を食べる魔物に襲われて 壊滅しているらしいの
Entry.EnglishText: Sounds like several caravans were attacked by those dream-eating monsters.

Entry.JapaneseText: また、ぶっそうな 世の中に戻っちまうのかねぇ……
Entry.EnglishText: I sure hope the world won't fall back to chaos...

Entry.JapaneseText: チェン商会が各地に無料で 救援物資を配って回ってるんだ
Entry.EnglishText: The Chen Corporation is distributing relief supplies across the world, free of charge.

Entry.JapaneseText: さすがチェンだね…… あたしらも協力しなきゃ！
Entry.EnglishText: That's our Chen for you... We need to do our part, too!

Entry.JapaneseText: ヘンゼラの商人魂で 世界を支えるんだよ!!
Entry.EnglishText: We'll support the world with Hanselar's merchant spirit!

Entry.JapaneseText: 道具屋
おう、らっしゃい！
Entry.EnglishText: Ah, welcome!

Entry.JapaneseText: またよろしくなっ!!
Entry.EnglishText: Come again!

Entry.JapaneseText: へい、へい、へい！ ウチの防具を見てってくれ！
Entry.EnglishText: Heya! You there! Come take a look at my amor!

Entry.JapaneseText: 硬くて、軽くて、扱いやすい 一級の防具がそろってるぜぇ!!
Entry.EnglishText: Our armor is of the finest quality. It's durable, lightweight and easy to use!

Entry.JapaneseText: チッ…… カラクリがばれちまったか。
Entry.EnglishText: Tch... Guess the jig is up.

Entry.JapaneseText: だが、だまされる方が悪いんだぜ
Entry.EnglishText: At least I wasn't the one gettin' duped.

Entry.JapaneseText: 買わないなら、あっちへ行けよ
Entry.EnglishText: If you're not buyin, keep moving.

Entry.JapaneseText: こんな俺だけど 昔は商売に夢をもってたんだ……
Entry.EnglishText: I'd always dream of making it big in business, but now look at me...

Entry.JapaneseText: ……もう汚い商売はしねぇよ
Entry.EnglishText: ...From now on, I'm gonna do things legit.

Entry.JapaneseText: うおぉぉ！ 俺の商人ダマシィの見せどころだ！
Entry.EnglishText: Whoooa! My merchant's spirit is burnin' bright!

Entry.JapaneseText: 街の警護団に無料で 最高の防具を貸し出すぜ！
Entry.EnglishText: We'll lend out our finest armor to the city's guards, free of charge!

Entry.JapaneseText: 商人ダマシィで ダマシ商人を卒業するんだっ!!
Entry.EnglishText: No more of my swindling ways, I'm a new man!

Entry.JapaneseText: さぁ、いかがです？ 業物のブロードソードが 入荷してますよ！
Entry.EnglishText: Nice, ain't it? We've got a range of broadswords now in stock!

Entry.JapaneseText: 近頃、魔物が凶暴化してますからね 一流の武器を持たないと危険ですよ
Entry.EnglishText: All the monster's have been extra savage lately. It's dangerous to go without a first-class weapon in hand.

Entry.JapaneseText: ふん、チェン大人に逆らっては 商売を続けられません……
Entry.EnglishText: Hmph, I can't keep my business going by makin' an enemy of Papa Chen...

Entry.JapaneseText: けどね、だまされるのが 悪いんですよ
Entry.EnglishText: Even so, I'm better of than those who got swindled.

Entry.JapaneseText: そうさ、先にだました者の 勝ちなんだ……
Entry.EnglishText: The first to cheat, wins. That's the way it is.

Entry.JapaneseText: スピリアを入れ替えて マジメにやってますよ……
Entry.EnglishText: I've had a real change of Spiria.

Entry.JapaneseText: わたしは子どもの頃から 武器屋になりたかったんだ
Entry.EnglishText: I've wanted to own my on weapon Store ever since I was a little boy.

Entry.JapaneseText: ……サギ師に なりたかった訳じゃない……
Entry.EnglishText: I never wanted to be a conman.

Entry.JapaneseText: 今こそ、正義の商人として 生まれ変わるチャンスです！
Entry.EnglishText: But now's my big chance to turn over a new leaf and be an honest merchant!

Entry.JapaneseText: わ、わたしはやりますよっ!! ………………怖いけど
素材屋
いらっしゃいませ♪ ロット鮎はヘンゼラの 特産素材ですよ！
Entry.EnglishText: Welcome! ♪ Try Hanselar's signature lott sweetfish!

Entry.JapaneseText: ありがとうございましたぁ♪
Entry.EnglishText: Thank you! ♪

Entry.JapaneseText: ……売り上げが減ってる……
Entry.EnglishText: Sales are decreasing...

Entry.JapaneseText: となりの店がウチの悪口でも 広めてるんじゃないだろうね……？
Entry.EnglishText: Maybe the next store over's been smack talking us behind our backs?

Entry.JapaneseText: 疑いたくないけど しょせん商売は食うか 食われるかだからね……
Entry.EnglishText: I hate to doubt them, but when it comes to business, it's a dog eat dog world.

Entry.JapaneseText: 隣の店には負けませんよ
Entry.EnglishText: I'm not about to lose to the folks next door.

Entry.JapaneseText: 隣のじぃさんとは もう三十年も 競い合って商売してるのよ
Entry.EnglishText: I've been doing business with the old man next door for thirty years now.

Entry.JapaneseText: こんな時一番怖いのは 民衆のパニックだよ
Entry.EnglishText: The last thing we wan't at a time like this is public panic.

Entry.JapaneseText: 商人が冷静でないと パニックをあおる事になっちまう
Entry.EnglishText: If us merchants lose our cool, everyone's gonna start getting restless.

Entry.JapaneseText: 海運ギルドと陸運ギルドも 協力して動きだしたよ！
Entry.EnglishText: The Maritime Guild and Shipping Guild have started collaborating!

Entry.JapaneseText: 商人は商人のやり方で 世界をひとつにつなげるのさ！
Entry.EnglishText: Merchants bring the world together through our trade!

Entry.JapaneseText: ……売り上げがあがらん……
Entry.EnglishText: Sales are increasing...

Entry.JapaneseText: となりの奴が うちの店の悪口を 流しとるのかもしれん
Entry.EnglishText: The old man next door better not go bad mouthing our store and screwing it up.

Entry.JapaneseText: 油断して相手を信じたら バカをみるのが商人……
Entry.EnglishText: A merchant who lets his guard down and starts trusting others is bound to be played like a fool...

Entry.JapaneseText: ……いや、人間だからのぅ
Entry.EnglishText: ...No, that goes for people in general.

Entry.JapaneseText: うちの店は毎日が特売日だ
Entry.EnglishText: Everyday's a sale at my store.

Entry.JapaneseText: どれもワシがめききした 一級品ばかりだぞ!!
Entry.EnglishText: Only the finest, expertly curated items here!

Entry.JapaneseText: 世の中が乱れた時、怖いのは 人々がパニックになる事じゃな
Entry.EnglishText: When the world's turned on its head, the thing we should fear most is people panicking.

Entry.JapaneseText: パニックにつけこんで もうけようとするのは 最低最悪の商人じゃ
Entry.EnglishText: Merchants who try and make a quick gald by taking advantage of their fear are the worst.

Entry.JapaneseText: 真の商人は、人々を 安心させるために知恵を しぼるはずなんじゃ
Entry.EnglishText: A true merchant should use their wits to make people feel at ease.

Entry.JapaneseText: なんたって客が豊かでなきゃ 商人はもうけられないんじゃから！
Entry.EnglishText: I mean, merchant's can't make money if our customers are broke!

Entry.JapaneseText: ひどいわ……どの店も 客をだまそうとするの……
Entry.EnglishText: Every store here's out to con people... How awful...

Entry.JapaneseText: ヘンゼラって油断できない イヤな街ね……
Entry.EnglishText: So Hanselar is an unsavory town where you can't let your guard slip for a moment...

Entry.JapaneseText: 欲しいものがたくさん ありすぎて迷っちゃうわ……
Entry.EnglishText: There's so many things I want, I don't even know where to start...

Entry.JapaneseText: あなたが買って、私に プレゼントしてくれるといいのに
Entry.EnglishText: Why can't you just buy it as a gift to me?

Entry.JapaneseText: 統一戦争前には 食べる物がない人が たくさんいたらしいけど
Entry.EnglishText: Apparently before the Unification War, many people went without food on their plates.

Entry.JapaneseText: 信じられないわねぇ？
Entry.EnglishText: Hard to imagine, right?

Entry.JapaneseText: 食べる物もないなんて どんな状態？ 信じられないわよね??
Entry.EnglishText: What would it be like to have no food? I can't begin to imagine!

Entry.JapaneseText: この交易の街で 物が不足するなんて……
Entry.EnglishText: There's a supply shortage even in a city of commerce like this...

Entry.JapaneseText: 地方の街は もっとひどい事に なってるんじゃないかしら？
Entry.EnglishText: I wonder how bad things are in rural towns?

Entry.JapaneseText: ここがバレイア教の 教会だよ
Entry.EnglishText: This is a Velleian Church.

Entry.JapaneseText: 初対面のぼくの言う事なんて 信じられないだろうけどね……
Entry.EnglishText: This is only the first time we've met, so I doubt you'd believe me...

Entry.JapaneseText: ここがバレイア教の 教会だよ
Entry.EnglishText: This is a Velleian Church.

Entry.JapaneseText: 信じられないなら、別に 信じなくてもいいけどね……
Entry.EnglishText: If you don't believe me, that's fine.

Entry.JapaneseText: ぼくもいつか チェンさんみたいになりたいな
Entry.EnglishText: I wanna be just like Papa Chen one day.

Entry.JapaneseText: ぼくもえらくなって 美人のメガネ秘書を はべらすんだ！
Entry.EnglishText: I'm gonna have a pretty secretary with glasses working for me, too!

Entry.JapaneseText: おとぎ話のとおりに 怪物がゲンジツに出てきた……
Entry.EnglishText: That thing is just like the fairy tale, but REAL...

Entry.JapaneseText: ……って事は おとぎ話のとおりに 世界は消えちゃうのかな？
Entry.EnglishText: ...Does that mean the world's gonna end like in the fairy tale, too?

Entry.JapaneseText: ぼくの美人秘書をはべらすユメは かなわないかもね……
Entry.EnglishText: My dream of a pretty secretary might not come true...

Entry.JapaneseText: さっきね、エカイユさんが 『あきらめちゃだめ』って 声をかけてくれたんだ……∀
Entry.EnglishText: Earlier, Miss Ecaille called out to me and said “don't give up!”... hehe ∀

Entry.JapaneseText: ぼく、あきらめないよ！ 美人メガネ秘書をはべらす ユメをかなえるまではっ!!
Entry.EnglishText: I won't give up! Not until my dream secretary is a reality!
